description: Search Pakistan's federal statute register (The Pakistan Code, Ministry of Law and Justice) by words in the Act title, optionally filtered by year and subject category (Criminal, Civil, Family, Labour, Banking, Evidence, ...). Returns act_id, title, category, citation (e.g. "XLV of 1860") and promulgation date. Title words only, e.g. "penal", "contract", "evidence".

category.description: Subject category name or number, e.g. "Criminal" or "1".

query.description: Words in the Act title, e.g. "penal code".

year.description: Four-digit year of the Act, e.g. "1860".

name: pk_search_acts
